page.layout: One printed page (page 153), one column of running text. Marginal notes in the right margin: "NB." beside the first paragraph, "Anglia." and "Sicilia." beside the following paragraphs. No left-margin text. Running head at the top, catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: rios respicias. Sed hæc felicitas cœli aerisque temperationi NB. non parum accepta ferenda est, quippe flores, rosæ scilicet, violæ & asparagus etiam, tribus tantum mensib.in anno illis defi-ciunt. In quibusdam etiam locis agros fertiles esse adeò traditur vt, cum semel sata frumenta sint, subinde recidiuis feminibus segetem novantibus septem minimum, interdum plures etiam ferant messes.

Hæc Romanis ante Dictatorem Cæsarem Anglia. parū fuit cognita, vt ex historiis patet: plæriq; enim fictā eam, nusquamq; extare omninoq; fabulosam contenderunt, teste Plut. Temperatius in ea & salubrius cœlum est quam in Gal-lia: imbribus tamen ac nebulis crebriorib. ma-didum. Frugum pecorumq; fœcundum est ibi solum, Fruges citò proveniunt, sed tardè mitescunt, omnibusque iis quæ tàm pecora, quàm homines benignius alant, præclarè abundat. Hibernia iniquum habet ad maturanda semina cœlum, verùm herbis lætis & dulcib. adeo luxuriat, vt se exigua diei parte pecora imple-ant, & nisi pabulo prohibeantur, difficiliant diu-ti[?] sc.pasta. Vina in Anglia nulla, à Gallis enim Germanisque ea petunt, & quidem fortiora, quia imbecilla vecturam non ferunt.
Sicilia, Sicilia. cui Anglia maximè similis nonnul-lis videtur figura sc.triquetra, fertilitate nullis pene terris comparanda venit. Tulit Cererem frugum inuentricem : Unde fit vt quicquid

page.notes: Printed text ends at the catchword "gignat." on the right and the signature "K 5" on the left. Doubtful readings: the colon after "Gal-lia" may be a printed colon or a pointing mark; "diu-ti" has a raised figure or mark after "ti" that I could not identify; "vecturam" has a macron or tilde that is hard to read. Running head copied as "PROROGANDA". The Greek and Hebrew checks found none on this page.
